name: Clotting adds 25% Physical damage to Aortic Assault's closing burst against a bleeding target (#505)
contract: Clotting 704115 reads: 'At the end of Aortic Assault's duration, all enemies in a 10 yd frontal cone suffer ${$806214m1*$<scalingbp>+$AP*0.5} Physical damage. Damage dealt by this effect is increased by $s2% against bleeding targets.' Spell.dbc 704115 effect 1 is aura 112 with the raw Ascension selector 20007 (ASCENSION_CLASSMASK_AURASTATE_DAMAGE), MiscValueB 18 (AURA_STATE_BLEEDING), BasePoints 24 -> 25 and EffectSpellClassMask (0, 5242880, 0), which is 806214's own SpellFamilyFlags. Like Terrorizer and Enduring, it is converted at load to SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE, whose class-mask variant in Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone multiplies only 806214's damage and only against a victim in the bleeding aura state. Expected: with Clotting learned, spell_damage_done(806214) against a bleeding target is 1.25x the same query against a clean target; without Clotting the ratio is exactly 1.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
